blurb: Guests can climb on indoor rock walls with options for day passes, gear rentals, memberships, and group programs including birthday parties and scout badge programs. The facility offers climbing for all ages with staff belays and special events. Equipment rentals and safety harnesses are provided as needed.
extraNote: Deposit of 50% required at time of registration for summer camp · Staff belay availability should be confirmed by phone or email · Prices do not include tax or credit card fees · New Heights Summer Camp runs June 29th to August 28th
